transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because my brain just kind of stalls out. I’ll have a test report or even a simple CAD note open, and I can sit there for an hour unable to figure out what the next sentence—or even the next checkbox—should be.
How long have you been experiencing these difficulties with your thinking and focus?
Since I was moved into the prototype-testing role—about a year and a month ago.
Aside from the focus issues, have you been experiencing a consistently low or depressed mood?
I’m not really sure what counts as depressed mood. I mostly notice the thinking problem at work.
Did you experience similar problems with attention or focus during your childhood or school years?
I’m not sure. I don’t really remember having this kind of problem in school.
Do you feel mentally drained or exhausted after trying to concentrate or do mental work?
Yeah. It’s like my brain just stalls out. I’ll have a test report or even a simple CAD note open, and I can sit there for an hour not knowing what the next sentence or checkbox should be.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in doing things you normally enjoy outside of work?

Yeah. My miniature printer has had the same half-finished figure sitting in it for months. Even yoga or going for a walk in the woods just feels like another task now, not something I actually want to do.
How has your sleep been over the past few months?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to it, I guess.
Have you noticed a drop in your energy levels or felt physically tired most days?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really noticed whether my energy is lower most days.
Have you been feeling worthless or blaming yourself excessively for things?
Yeah. I keep going over little mistakes I made in the lab and thinking I’m not just bad at my job—I’m a bad person. Like I deserve whatever happens because of it.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed any clear change in my appetite or weight.
Have you had any thoughts of death, or that you would be better off dead?
Yeah. On my commute, I sometimes think it would be easier if I just didn’t arrive anywhere. And sometimes I think about steering off the road—it scares me enough that I grip the wheel and pull over.
Have you or anyone else noticed that you are moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual?

Yeah. In meetings, people have started finishing my sentences because it takes me so long to get an answer out. Even walking from my desk to the test chamber feels like I’m moving through thick syrup.
